name: MonarchDiffViewer
title: DiffViewer
wrapsNative: LazyVStack of rows of monospaced Text built from AttributedString (background, strikethrough and underline attributes), in a ScrollViewReader; Picker with .pickerStyle(.segmented) for the layout and MonarchButton for previous, next and expand
summary: Shows what changed between two texts or two versions of a document, unified or side by side: added and removed lines, changed words inside them, folded unchanged runs, totals and previous and next change buttons.
whenToUse: To review changes between two versions of a text, a configuration or a document (one block per paragraph), for example in a version history or before restoring a version.
whenNotToUse: Not for a patch that is already a diff (use MonarchCodeBlock with isDiff), not for comparing records field by field (use MonarchMergeDialog) and not for timesheet changes (use MonarchTimesheetDiff).
api: init(before: [String], after: [String], mode: Binding<MonarchDiffViewerMode>? = nil, granularity: MonarchDiffViewerGranularity = .word, context: Int? = 3, beforeLabel: String? = nil, afterLabel: String? = nil, showsModeSwitch: Bool = true, showsLineNumbers: Bool = true, labels: MonarchDiffViewerLabels = MonarchDiffViewerLabels(), @ViewBuilder actions: () -> Actions)

init(before: String, after: String, mode: Binding<MonarchDiffViewerMode>? = nil, granularity: MonarchDiffViewerGranularity = .word, context: Int? = 3, beforeLabel: String? = nil, afterLabel: String? = nil, showsModeSwitch: Bool = true, showsLineNumbers: Bool = true, labels: MonarchDiffViewerLabels = MonarchDiffViewerLabels(), @ViewBuilder actions: () -> Actions)

init(before: [String], after: [String], mode: Binding<MonarchDiffViewerMode>? = nil, granularity: MonarchDiffViewerGranularity = .word, context: Int? = 3, beforeLabel: String? = nil, afterLabel: String? = nil, showsModeSwitch: Bool = true, showsLineNumbers: Bool = true, labels: MonarchDiffViewerLabels = MonarchDiffViewerLabels()) where Actions == EmptyView

static func MonarchDiffViewerLine.diff(from before: [String], to after: [String]) -> [MonarchDiffViewerLine]
enum MonarchDiffViewerLineKind { case same, added, removed }

struct MonarchDiffViewerLabels { init(caption: (@Sendable (String, String) -> String)? = nil, before: String? = nil, after: String? = nil, mode: String? = nil, unified: String? = nil, split: String? = nil, stats: (@Sendable (Int, Int) -> String)? = nil, added: String? = nil, removed: String? = nil, blankLine: String? = nil, expand: (@Sendable (Int) -> String)? = nil, previous: String? = nil, next: String? = nil, position: (@Sendable (Int, Int) -> String)? = nil, noChanges: String? = nil) }

options.name: before
options.description: The earlier text, split on line breaks, or its lines or blocks (one entry per paragraph for a document).

options.name: after
options.description: The later text, in the same shape.

options.name: mode
options.description: The layout when the app owns it. nil shows side by side at regular width and unified otherwise, and the reader's choice in the switch is kept inside the view.

options.name: granularity
options.description: word also marks the changed words inside a changed line; line marks whole lines only.

options.name: context
options.description: Unchanged lines kept around each change; longer runs fold behind a Show N unchanged lines button. nil never folds.

options.name: beforeLabel
options.description: The name of the earlier side, such as a version name; read in the caption and for side by side rows.

options.name: afterLabel
options.description: The name of the later side.

options.name: showsModeSwitch
options.description: Whether the segmented layout switch is shown. It is only shown at regular width.

options.name: showsLineNumbers
options.description: Whether line numbers are shown: both numbers in unified, one per side in side by side.

options.name: actions
options.description: Controls at the end of the header, such as Restore.

states.name: unified
states.description: One column: removed lines, then added lines of each change, each with both line numbers and a + or − marker.

states.name: side by side
states.description: Two columns: the k-th removed line beside the k-th added line; an empty side has the subtle fill.

states.name: folded
states.description: Unchanged runs longer than the context fold into a full-width button that shows them.

states.name: current change
states.description: After previous or next, the first row of that change has an accent bar at its leading edge and is scrolled into view.

states.name: no changes
states.description: "No changes." in the muted text colour instead of the lines.

appearance: Added lines use the subtle success fill and removed lines the subtle danger fill; changed words have the success or danger border colour as a fill, removed words are struck through and added words underlined. Markers and totals use the strong success and danger colours, line numbers the subtle text colour, inside a container with a subtle border.
platformNotes: The diff algorithm is ported from the web (longest common subsequence over lines, then over words, with the same limits), not shared. The web is a table that scrolls sideways; on iOS long lines wrap so the text scales with Dynamic Type, and the layout switch appears only at regular width because two columns do not fit a phone. Previous and next scroll with ScrollViewReader and move VoiceOver focus; scrolling needs the view inside the app's ScrollView. Android uses the same name and options.
accessibility: The lines are a container named "Changes from <before> to <after>".
Each unified line is one element read as its text after "Added" or "Removed"; an empty line reads "Blank line". Line numbers are not read.
A side by side row reads each side after its name, or once when the line is unchanged.
Previous and next announce "Change 2 of 5" and move VoiceOver focus to the change.
Changes are marked by + and − signs, strikethrough and underline as well as colour.
Text scales with Dynamic Type and wraps; buttons have 44-point touch targets.
edgeCases: Inputs with more than a million line pairs show every line removed and added; lines with more than 250,000 word pairs are not split into words.
A change of the texts resets the expanded runs and the current change.
A run of unchanged lines only one longer than the context is shown instead of folded.
An empty before shows every line as added.
